book.name: 2Korinto
book.title: 2Korinto Korinto Ekalesia Azaḡa veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa Aheuḡa

content: Emeꞌe Badiꞌa teite gaueꞌeteꞌe azaḡa radu zae mazao inare ziꞌohe. Badiꞌaꞌa zae mazao manoḡa furenirotaꞌaꞌe huga oꞌoꞌa teige ago mae modoꞌi.

content.text: “Eḡeꞌa ḡae mazao manoḡa furenihi rae reiroteꞌe madaḡano ḡae umido igiro,
ebu ḡae ḡaboꞌihi rae reiroteꞌe madaḡano ḡae danaꞌiro.”

content: Ḡianoꞌi, izidiꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa emeḡe mazao manoḡa furenihi rae raꞌeteꞌe madaḡa, ebu izidiꞌe eme ḡabofihi rae raꞌeteꞌe madaḡa.
Vazeꞌe emeꞌa gaueꞌetaꞌaꞌe veꞌoḡa rae mene rofoga veize, emeꞌa vazeni ꞌahoga ibi mene ꞌuiro.

U emeꞌa nagi gau haḡaeꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano emeꞌe Badiꞌa tuḡure azaḡano rae fureniro. Zamafe borofe obone gigaruꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, aduga hideꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, zamafeꞌa aduduꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, zu ibifeꞌa turauꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano,

vazeꞌa masifeꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, ḡuꞌa neḡano ohofeꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, maḡunu azaḡaniꞌa utitofiꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, gau ufeta boro haḡaeꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, mene bazeꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano zu vinini tare radiuꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano, emeꞌe Badiꞌa tuḡure azaḡano rae fureniro.

Ebu zamafe deheḡano haḡaeꞌenaꞌa, Badiꞌa moneo faine edereꞌenaꞌa, zamafe rinedeꞌenaꞌa, vaze mazao manoḡa haḡaeꞌenaꞌa, Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa eme ibitofiꞌenaꞌa, ebu hugano zamafe niduꞌa hina vaze zamare borofeꞌenaꞌa,
ḡoere huga harameꞌenaꞌa, Badiꞌa gigiꞌaḡa hina gaueꞌenaꞌa, duduḡa haḡaoga veize utiteꞌohe. Eꞌe madaḡano uti ḡauḡa edaꞌe zu kauri ꞌevoꞌano oboneꞌenaꞌa, emeꞌe Badiꞌa tuḡure azaḡano rae fureniro.

Vazeꞌa nife mae ḡihineꞌetene zu mae ovoeꞌetene, ebu eme rae sausaufeꞌetene zu nigufeꞌetene zuni, emeꞌe Badiꞌa tuḡure azaḡano rae fureniro. Vaze nuꞌa eme vaze soꞌosoꞌozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa rae raꞌohe, rehano eme hugano harameꞌohe.

Vaze nuꞌa emeꞌe Badiꞌa tuḡure azaḡa rae mene edereꞌohe, rehano nuꞌe huga hune ederadu mae ḡihifeꞌohe. Vazeꞌa eme rudaꞌuma rae raꞌohe, rehano ḡiꞌanoꞌi, eme ꞌize ḡabode radiuꞌohe. Zeꞌa masifeꞌohe, rehano mene uḡufeꞌohe.
Zamafe aduduꞌohe, rehano emeꞌe iḡaiḡa matuꞌe rudauꞌohe, eme zahara azaḡa, rehano vaze ḡehaḡa danazadu ze maꞌora azaḡa rae raꞌohe, ebu emeḡe mazao ḡau oꞌoꞌa, rehano Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo ḡau niduꞌa meiro.
Korinto ekalesia azaḡa, eme mene ḡurireꞌenaꞌa ḡoreziro ebu zae mazao zamafe ufeta bohaniro.
Emeꞌa zae zamareꞌetaꞌaꞌe mene zorereꞌohe, rehano zaeꞌa eme zamareꞌetaꞌaꞌe zorereꞌohe.
Eꞌe eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziꞌeteꞌe teige zae ziꞌohe. Emeḡe zamarone naenaenadu zae zama zuni borofe bohanoꞌi.
Badiꞌa aḡuꞌa azaḡa teite ago tiburanoꞌi. Duduḡa zu sauꞌaꞌe tiburanoga mene idaḡa, ebu agaḡa zu uzaboꞌe tiburanoga mene idaḡa.
teite unihotitoga idaḡahe? Fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zu mene fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano idaidaḡa nu ꞌahoga eꞌehe?
Badiꞌa kuru neḡaꞌe vazeꞌa haḡairoteꞌe badiꞌaḡa teite tiburanoga idaḡahe? Emeꞌe ḡabode radiuꞌeteꞌe Badiꞌaḡa kuru neḡa. Eꞌe moneo Buka Zaḡoḡano Badiꞌaꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro,

content.text: “Eꞌe zeḡe teite radiꞌuma zu zeḡe boꞌaḡano ragaviꞌuma.
Ebu eꞌe zeḡe Badiꞌa reꞌuma zu zeꞌe eḡe none azaḡa reꞌuma.”
“Eḡe, Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa ꞌahige raꞌohe, 'Zaꞌe zeḡe mazaonoꞌo vaḡinoꞌi ebu avo radoꞌi.
Ḡau mene deheḡaꞌe ago obonoꞌi, ꞌougine eḡeꞌa zae mae ḡihiziꞌuma.'”
“Eḡe, Zuhiꞌa Boro Gigiꞌaḡaniꞌa ꞌahige raꞌohe, 'Eꞌe zae Moze reꞌuma zu zaꞌe eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa reꞌuma.'”
